launch_task_run: launch a new Mephisto task run from a DictConfig with blueprint, architect, and crowd provider settings
launch_task_run_or_die: launch a Mephisto task run from config and raise exceptions on failure instead of returning None
launch_from_incomplete_run: resume an incomplete Mephisto TaskRun by deploying the server and relaunching assignments and units
shutdown_operator: shut down the Mephisto Operator and all tracked task runs, expiring units and closing client connections
force_shutdown_operator: force a best-effort shutdown of the Mephisto Operator with a timeout for each shutdown step
